content: वैदेहः [विदेह अण्] .²1 A king of Videha; जनको ह वैदेहो बहुदक्षिणेन यज्ञेनेजे <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 1</ls>. .²2 An inhabitant of Videha. .²3 A trader by caste. .²4 The son of a Vaiśya by a Brāhmaṇa woman; <ls>Ms. 10 11</ls>. .²5 An attendant on the womenʼs apartments. .{@-हाः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) The people of Videha. .{@-ही@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Sītā; वैदेहिबन्धोर्हृदयं विदद्रे <ls>R. 14. 33</ls> (the final vowel in वैदेही being shortened.) .²2 The wife of a merchant. .²3 A sort of pigment (रोचना) .²4 Turmeric. .²5 A cow. .²6 Long pepper.
